input.summary: Add a Customer 30-day convenience termination right with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, bar Vendor convenience termination, and conform the take-or-pay clause.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need a customer termination-for-convenience right in a three-year committed term, so we have added a 30 days' notice right with a pro-rata refund of all prepaid Fees for the post-termination period and confirmed Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. We have also conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay commitment no longer negates that termination right, while leaving the no-reduction restriction intact.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund, on a pro-rata basis, all prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction rights but subject to Customer's termination rights.
